context: Reference coverage: an explicit review of four error messages in a payment webhook. A good review rewrites each one in the team form (cannot <verb> <thing> "<value>": <expected or next step>), removes the card number and API key from the log line, and restores the exception cause.

checklist.name: Creates review.md artifact
checklist.description: Creates review.md with the findings instead of answering only in chat.

checklist.name: Preserves webhook behavior
checklist.description: Proposed fixes keep the same exception types, signature check, accepted event types, and capture call; only message text, logged values, and exception chaining change.

checklist.name: Flags the leaked card number and API key
checklist.description: States that the log line exposes the full card number and the gateway API key, and gives a replacement that names the charge or the last four digits without either secret.

checklist.name: Rewrites each message in the team form
checklist.description: Gives a replacement for the signature, event type, log, and RuntimeError messages that starts with lowercase 'cannot', a verb, and the thing that failed, quotes a non-secret offending value such as the event type or charge id, and ends after a colon with what was expected or the next step.

checklist.name: Restores the exception cause
checklist.description: Points out that 'from None' hides the TimeoutError and replaces it with 'from err' or an equivalent that keeps the cause attached.

checklist.name: Drops decoration from messages
checklist.description: Replacement messages have no 'Error:', 'Invalid', or 'Failed to' prefix, no exclamation mark, no vague 'Something went wrong', and no trailing period.

checklist.name: Keeps the review focused
checklist.description: Stays on error reporting and does not propose unrelated refactors, new dependencies, or retry logic.
